'''Picutorion's spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located on the planet [[Picutorion/Legends|Picutorion]].

==History==
After the [[Raid on Picutorion|Battle of Picutorion]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] squad tried to evacuate the planet but was eliminated in Picutorion's spaceport by a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] unit led by [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]].
